name: Area Autopilot
description: Pick two corners (X Z) and auto-walk or auto-fly (elytra) a sweep pattern over the whole area. v1.10.2: walk-mode elytra-fly lands safely without fireworks; low elytra durability ends in a (safe-landing +) disconnect; mending/repair removed; A/B + progress saved before disconnect. v1.10.3: /autopilot cache clear (manual only, never on disconnect) resets points A/B, progress, path and caches; /autopilot trail on|off and /autopilot trail color <name|#hex|r g b> draw your flight path (behind and ahead of you) as a colored particle line.
